[september 16th to september 22nd](https://help.neostella.com/hc/en-us/articles/43157163401367-september-2026-release-notes#h_01M35QCTKW76JNY8Z69XQF3MM2) 4. [september 9th to september 15th](https://help.neostella.com/hc/en-us/articles/43157163401367-september-2026-release-notes#h_01M35QKDN0TSE2J405WP202268) 5. [september 2nd to september 8th](https://help.neostella.com/hc/en-us/articles/43157163401367-september-2026-release-notes#h_01M236JZCPKKS2Q6CGNS5A2WTG) 7. [september 1st](https://help.neostella.com/hc/en-us/articles/43157163401367-september-2026-release-notes#h_01M236M5C9R24G6XEXS7VVAZAK) These release notes summarize the **new features, latest updates, and bug fixes** from this month in Neostella platform. For detailed information of product-specific changes, please **visit our Help Center articles.** ## september 23rd to september 29th ### adoption | | | | --- | --- | | ![](https://help.neostella.com/hc/article_attachments/43157180181271) | **Migrate Deadline Chains**
Imports Deadline Chain data from Filevine into Neostella as Custom Objects under Projects and Leads, populated with current field values using the existing field mapping capability. Automatic recalculation between fields is out of scope. | | ![](https://help.neostella.com/hc/article_attachments/43157180181271) | **Implement Calendar Events Migration**
Adds Calendar Events as a new entity in the migration pipeline so firms' scheduling data, including attendees and dates, is preserved and accessible in Neostella after migration, following a documented mapping approach. | | ![](https://help.neostella.com/hc/article_attachments/43157180181271) | **Rename the step to create the migration bucket**
This update includes internal improvements that do not impact the user experience. | | ![](https://help.neostella.com/hc/article_attachments/43157180181271) | **Split Manifest by Maximum Document Limit**
This update includes internal improvements that do not impact the user experience. | | ![](https://help.neostella.com/hc/article_attachments/43157180181271) | **Mapping - Value Alignment new row on top of the list**
This update includes internal improvements that do not impact the user experience. | | ![](https://help.neostella.com/hc/article_attachments/43157180181271) | **Support Mapping for Global Objects**
Migration specialists can now map fields from Contacts and Projects directly into Global Objects, ensuring shared data lands in the correct cross-entity structure instead of being forced into an entity-specific target. This eliminates the need for workarounds when data belongs to a shared object that is referenced across multiple entities. | | ![](https://help.neostella.com/hc/article_attachments/43157180181271) | **Support Multi-Field Conditional Value Alignment for Single-Value Object Type**
Value Alignment now supports combining conditions across multiple source fields using AND or OR logic to determine a single target value such as Object Type, Stage, or Is Archived. | | ![](https://help.neostella.com/hc/article_attachments/43157180181271) | **Support Multiple Source Fields Within a Single Value Alignment for Object Tags**
Migration specialists can now register values from more than one source field within a single Value Alignment configuration for Object Tags, eliminating the need to create a separate operator per source field. | | ![](https://help.neostella.com/hc/article_attachments/43157180181271) | **Mapping List into Numbered Accordion**
This update includes internal improvements that do not impact the user experience. | | ![](https://help.neostella.com/hc/article_attachments/43157163395351) | **Task Type Field Options Not Displaying in Value Map on Mapping Canvas**
Minor bug fixes and internal improvements. | ### automations | | | | --- | --- | | ![](https://help.neostella.com/hc/article_attachments/43157180181271) | **Duplicate automation**
Users can duplicate an automation in the same tenant. | ### communications | | | | --- | --- | | ![](https://help.neostella.com/hc/article_attachments/43157180181271) | **Configure tenant custom domain**
We'll configure your firm's own domain for your account, so it's ready to use from day one. You'll be able to see which domain your emails are sending from right in Control Center — no separate setup required on your end. | | ![](https://help.neostella.com/hc/article_attachments/43157180181271) | **Improve and unify the empty message**
Standardized the empty-state messaging across Calls, Emails, Faxes, and SMS, so users always see a clear, consistent explanation when there's nothing to display yet instead of a blank screen. | | ![](https://help.neostella.com/hc/article_attachments/43157180181271) | **Tenant email using configured domain (In & Out)**
All emails sent from your firm — and everything that comes into your general firm inbox — will show your own domain, not a shared Neostella address. | | ![](https://help.neostella.com/hc/article_attachments/43157180181271) | **Embed Zoom contact center user experience improvements**
The panel now stays docked to the bottom-right corner as users navigate the app or open new tabs, and can be collapsed or expanded without ending the call. | | ![](https://help.neostella.com/hc/article_attachments/43157180181271) | **Provider Set-up (OAuth)**
Firm admins can now connect their RingCentral account via OAuth, mapping RingCentral extensions to individual users so calls attribute to the right person. | | ![](https://help.neostella.com/hc/article_attachments/43157180181271) | **Make, receive, and view Calls**
Allows users to make, receive and view phone call history directly from the platform using RingCentral. | | ![](https://help.neostella.com/hc/article_attachments/43157180181271) | **View call artifacts inside the Call details (Zoom or RingCentral)**
Users can now view and play a call's related files — transcript, recording, or voicemail — directly within the call details view. | | ![](https://help.neostella.com/hc/article_attachments/43157180181271) | **Manual call tracking ability, just to add a Call entry via UI**
Users can now manually log calls that happened outside the app, capturing direction, outcome, participants, and timing. | ### core | | | | --- | --- | | ![](https://help.neostella.com/hc/article_attachments/43157180181271) | BREAKING CHANGE
**System object grid views ignore object builder display settings**
The columns that tenant admins choose in the Display tab of the Object Builder now actually appear in the grid views for system objects (Leads, Contacts, Organizations and Projects), instead of a fixed set decided by the platform. | | ![](https://help.neostella.com/hc/article_attachments/43157180181271) | **Update default wording – "Filter Sections" to "Filter Menu"**
The label of the sidebar filter in the contact detail view changes to "Filter Menu", which is more intuitive and consistent with the navigation. Tenants that have customized this label keep their own wording. | | ![](https://help.neostella.com/hc/article_attachments/43157180181271) | **Apply permissions on Account / Webhooks**
Admins now have granular control over who can manage webhook subscriptions in Control Center, with dedicated View, Create, Edit, and Delete permissions for the Webhooks section. | | ![](https://help.neostella.com/hc/article_attachments/43157180181271) | **Project creation button and permissions discrepancy**
The buttons for creating projects, people, organizations and leads are now only visible to users who have permission to create them, instead of showing the button and only rejecting the request afterward. | | ![](https://help.neostella.com/hc/article_attachments/43157180181271) | **Select content for a package**
Release Center users can select the workflows, automations, objects and forms they want to move and bundle them into a single named package that can later be moved into a sandbox. | | ![](https://help.neostella.com/hc/article_attachments/43157180181271) | **Reuse Partner Hub's package detail view for package review**
The package review screen reuses the package detail view that Partner Hub already has, so Release Center users can see a package's full contents and its version history in one familiar place. | | ![](https://help.neostella.com/hc/article_attachments/43157180181271) | **Independent scroll on the package configuration screen**
Each column on the package configuration screen now scrolls on its own, instead of the whole page scrolling, so users can review a long list of content without losing their place elsewhere on the screen. | | ![](https://help.neostella.com/hc/article_attachments/43157180181271) | **Import / Apply Package**
Users with access to the Publish space can review an incoming package and apply it to their sandbox (or the main tenant), so configuration built elsewhere shows up in their environment. | | ![](https://help.neostella.com/hc/article_attachments/43157180181271) | **Sandbox Management: UX/UI and BE enhancements feedback**
A set of small usability and clarity improvements to Sandbox Management, based on feedback after its first release — clearer labels, full user names and emails, a refresh option, a "Created by" column, easier deletion, and a subdomain preview. | | ![](https://help.neostella.com/hc/article_attachments/43157180181271) | **Default Stage value on Lead/Project creation**
New Leads now start with a default Stage instead of showing "N/A" until someone sets it manually, matching what already happens for Projects. | | ![](https://help.neostella.com/hc/article_attachments/43157180181271) | **Case banner titles use incorrect capitalization for acronyms**
Case banner titles now show field names with the correct capitalization, for example "Lead POA" and "Last 4 of SSN," using the field's configured label. | ### customization | | | | --- | --- | | ![](https://help.neostella.com/hc/article_attachments/43157180181271) | **Button Execution Log**
Action buttons in forms and views give users no visibility into whether an action was previously executed or who triggered it. This improvement surfaces the last execution of each action button directly below it, showing who activated it and when. | | ![](https://help.neostella.com/hc/article_attachments/43157180181271) | **Create a new way to Get objects endpoint via POST**
The current Get objects endpoint uses a GET method, which limits the amount of filtering criteria that can be passed due to URL length constraints. Changing to a POST method with a structured payload removes those constraints and enables more efficient, flexible querying. | | ![](https://help.neostella.com/hc/article_attachments/43157163395351) | **PROD \| Objects \| Modal to select field still visible after leave the Form builder**
Fix on lookup field panel, to avoid overwriting on the platform. | ### documents | | | | --- | --- | | ![](https://help.neostella.com/hc/article_attachments/43157163394327) | **Add Tags to Templates and Filter grid by them**
Document templates can be tagged and users will be able to filter by them. | ### explore | | | | --- | --- | | ![](https://help.neostella.com/hc/article_attachments/43157180181271) | **Advanced Search & Reporting – Add Option to Include Archived Records**
Archived records are currently excluded automatically from Advanced Search and Reporting, with no option for users to include them. This adds an option in both Advanced Search and Report creation to include them when needed, while keeping them excluded by default. | | ![](https://help.neostella.com/hc/article_attachments/43157180181271) | **Add Clickable Record Links to Report Results**
Relevant record fields in Reports are now clickable links instead of static values, letting users move directly from reporting and analysis into reviewing or working the record identified by the report. | | ![](https://help.neostella.com/hc/article_attachments/43157180181271) | **Support Billable Amount Reporting for Time Entries**
Users can now report on billed amounts from Time Entries, allowing analysis of how much has been billed over different time periods. | | ![](https://help.neostella.com/hc/article_attachments/43157180181271) | **Support Tasks Completed Reporting by User Group**
Enables reporting on the number of completed tasks by user group, allowing measurement of task completion across different teams or groups. | | ![](https://help.neostella.com/hc/article_attachments/43157180181271) | **Refactor Reporting into a Unified Report-Centric Experience**
Organizes reports, executions, and schedules around the report/template, providing clearer context, reducing navigation, and making it easier to understand a report's latest execution, execution history, and scheduling configuration. | | ![](https://help.neostella.com/hc/article_attachments/43157180181271) | **Support Query Payload for Global Table Components - Light Reporting endpoint**
Enables Global Views to display dynamic, report-like tables by leveraging Explore's existing query capabilities. | ### finance | | | | --- | --- | | ![](https://help.neostella.com/hc/article_attachments/43157180181271) | **Configure Billable Fields in the Billing Section**
Once billing is enabled on a custom object, a dedicated Billing section appears in the Display tab where Case Support Specialists can select which fields from the object will be available for invoice line items. | | ![](https://help.neostella.com/hc/article_attachments/43157180181271) | **Enable Billing on a Custom Object**
Users can enable billing on any custom object directly from the object settings in Control Center. Once enabled, the object becomes available to be added as a line item on invoices, allowing firms to bill clients for charge types beyond fixed charges and time entries. | | ![](https://help.neostella.com/hc/article_attachments/43157180181271) | **Payments Table (Payments Relation View)**
Manually registered payments appear in the same Payments table as automatic payments, giving finance users a single consolidated view of all payments received across invoices regardless of how they were recorded. | | ![](https://help.neostella.com/hc/article_attachments/43157180181271) | **Payment Status: Manual**
Finance users can manually record payments received outside of an integrated payment provider — such as checks, wire transfers, or cash — directly against a sent invoice, with the invoice payment status updating automatically. | ### workflows | | | | --- | --- | | ![](https://help.neostella.com/hc/article_attachments/43157180181271) | **Duplicate workflow templates from the templates list view**
Anyone building workflow templates will be able to copy one or several existing templates in a single action, and get editable drafts to work from instead of rebuilding a process from scratch. | | ![](https://help.neostella.com/hc/article_attachments/43157180181271) | **Execution Title Header, From Attribute and Refresh**
Shows the record an execution belongs to directly in the execution header, as a link back to that record, and adds a refresh control that pulls current execution data without reloading the application. | ## september 16th to september 22nd ### adoption | | | | --- | --- | | ![](https://help.neostella.com/hc/article_attachments/43359811750423) | **Display Clean and User Friendly Error Messages:** Users now see clear and friendly error messages when something goes wrong, without any confusing technical details or sensitive information being exposed. This makes it easier to understand what happened and what to do next, improving trust and reducing the need to contact support for clarification. | | ![](https://help.neostella.com/hc/article_attachments/43359811750423) | **TASK Name: User want the TASK be named after the body:** Imported tasks will be named using the first 99 characters of their body text instead of a generic ID, falling back to the old naming only when the body is empty. | | ![](https://help.neostella.com/hc/article_attachments/43359811750423) | **Add chips to statuses in execution grid:** This update includes internal improvements that do not impact the user experience. | | ![](https://help.neostella.com/hc/article_attachments/43359811750423) | **Tenant (Tejo) Migration Bucket, requires policy for Import Files Sync endpoint user to write:** The tenant migration bucket now includes the necessary policy to allow the Import API Sync user to write manifest, data contract, and import files directly. This enables the sync process to operate correctly without manual credential workarounds or permission errors during import setup. | | ![](https://help.neostella.com/hc/article_attachments/43359811750423) | **Display Reconcile Progress in Execution Detail Panel (Replacing Cleaning Stage Tracking):** The Execution Detail panel now shows the Reconcile step as a tracked stage after Import completes, giving users full visibility into the final phase of their migration execution. | | ![](https://help.neostella.com/hc/article_attachments/43359811750423) | **Deprecate Cleaning Process V1 and Progress tracking:** The V1 cleaning process has been fully deprecated and removed from the execution pipeline, UI, and progress tracker, reducing complexity and eliminating an outdated step that is no longer needed. | | ![](https://help.neostella.com/hc/article_attachments/43359811750423) | **Add "Calculate" Operator to Support Math Operations Across Numeric Fields:** Migration specialists can now perform math operations such as addition, subtraction, multiplication, and division directly within the mapping canvas using the new Calculate operator, combining source fields and static values as needed. | | ![](https://help.neostella.com/hc/article_attachments/43359811750423) | **Add a link from the Execution Details panel to its related Mapping:** The mapping name in the Execution Details panel is now a clickable link that takes users directly to the mapping configuration, eliminating the need to manually copy the name and search for it in the Mapping tab. | | ![](https://help.neostella.com/hc/article_attachments/43359811751703) | **False invalid phone and email errors on Person edit:** Minor bug fixes and internal improvements. | | ![](https://help.neostella.com/hc/article_attachments/43359811751703) | **Staging \| Import \| Unsaved Changes Prompt Displayed When Exiting a Mapping Without Making Any Changes:** This update includes internal improvements that do not impact the user experience. | ### communications | | | | --- | --- | | ![](https://help.neostella.com/hc/article_attachments/43359811750423) | **Allow to create a contact or add to existing one from Unknown:** Users can now create a new contact or link an existing one directly from an unknown fax, without leaving the Fax view. Once associated, the fax updates instantly and moves out of the unknown list. | | ![](https://help.neostella.com/hc/article_attachments/43359811750423) | **View only Unknown:** Users can now filter faxes to show only those without a known contact associated, making it easier to spot and follow up on unidentified faxes without digging through the full list. | ### core | | | | --- | --- | | ![](https://help.neostella.com/hc/article_attachments/43359811750423) | **Date formatting:** Date fields are now consistently formatted across the platform, regardless of their field name. The backend marks each date field with a type indicator, allowing the frontend to format any date value correctly — including custom or renamed fields that previously displayed as raw strings. | | ![](https://help.neostella.com/hc/article_attachments/43359811750423) | **Restrict Limited Users' project/lead visibility to Access-associated records only:** Limited Users will only see the projects and leads they've explicitly been given access to; anything outside that scope stays hidden from their view, matching how Guest User access already works. | | ![](https://help.neostella.com/hc/article_attachments/43359811750423) | **Wire Recycle Bin FE actions to updated Restore, Purge, and List endpoints:** Users who restore or permanently delete items from the Recycle Bin will see that action correctly reflected across all related sub-items automatically, and the Recycle Bin will load deleted records more efficiently using pagination. | | ![](https://help.neostella.com/hc/article_attachments/43359811750423) | **Revoke Guest User access:** Admins can now manually revoke a Guest User's access to a project, immediately preventing them from viewing the project and its documents. | | ![](https://help.neostella.com/hc/article_attachments/43359811750423) | **Don't allow limited users to be linked to "Control Center" permission sets:** Prevents Limited Users from ever being assigned Control Center or Finance permission sets — directly or through a group — so external/limited accounts can't gain administrative access. | | ![](https://help.neostella.com/hc/article_attachments/43359811750423) | **Create new user as a limited user in Control Center:** Lets admins create a 'Limited User' directly in Control Center for external parties with scoped, ongoing access — without requiring a contact-based invitation first. | | ![](https://help.neostella.com/hc/article_attachments/43359811750423) | **Invite contact as a limited user from "Contacts" module:** Users with the permissions to do it can invite contacts who are not users as limited users. | | ![](https://help.neostella.com/hc/article_attachments/43359811750423) | **Identify contacts who are users:** Contacts who are users for the tenant have a visual indicator that tells the type of user (internal, partner, collaborator). | | ![](https://help.neostella.com/hc/article_attachments/43359811750423) | **Hide workspaces for users who do not have access to them:** Users only see the workspaces they actually have permission for in their navigation; Limited Users in particular never see Control Center or Finance. | ### customization | | | | --- | --- | | ![](https://help.neostella.com/hc/article_attachments/43359811750423) | **Project Role Visibility Widget for Views:** Users have no way to surface project role assignments directly within a custom view. This widget brings role visibility into the operational surface where users already work, without requiring navigation to the Access section. | | ![](https://help.neostella.com/hc/article_attachments/43359811750423) | **\[TECH\] GET object by selector endpoint:** There is no endpoint to retrieve a single object by its selector. This improvement adds a dedicated endpoint that returns a single object given its selector. | | ![](https://help.neostella.com/hc/article_attachments/43359811750423) | **Project deletion and restoration within Project Groups:** When a secondary project is deleted, its relationship to the Project Group and shared records must be handled cleanly. When restored, the project must rejoin the group with its original relationships intact. | | ![](https://help.neostella.com/hc/article_attachments/43359811750423) | **Document scope selector in relationship fields:** This improvement sets the default scope of a relationship field's document search to the current project — communicating it clearly with a help message — and allows users to switch to their full document access or to the project group when applicable. | | ![](https://help.neostella.com/hc/article_attachments/43359811750423) | **Form Builder: multi-select toolbox fields with checkboxes and insert them in one action:** Users can now check the fields they want in the toolbox and place them in a single action, with the selection surviving searching and filtering, instead of dragging fields out one at a time. | | ![](https://help.neostella.com/hc/article_attachments/43359811750423) | **Cascading cleanup when a field is deleted:** When a field is deleted from an object, all references to it are now automatically removed across headers, display info, view components, and calculated fields, and the admin is warned before confirming the deletion that dependent elements may be affected. | | ![](https://help.neostella.com/hc/article_attachments/43359811750423) | **Delete components:** Administrators can now delete a component from the Components section, automatically removing it from all views where it is currently in use, with a confirmation step that surfaces the impact before the action is committed. | ### documents | | | | --- | --- | | ![](https://help.neostella.com/hc/article_attachments/43359811750423) | **Unable to return to the All Documents grid from Selected Documents in Fact Packet creation:** Fixes a bug where, on projects without folders, users building a Fact Packet could get stuck on the Selected Documents screen with no way back to the full document list to pick more files. | | ![](https://help.neostella.com/hc/article_attachments/43690427372823) | **Add AND / OR operators to Conditionals in WAI:** Lets users building Word templates combine conditions with AND/OR logic, nest condition groups, and set a fallback value for when none match — enabling more complex document templates. | | ![](https://help.neostella.com/hc/article_attachments/43690427372823) | **Add TODAY to PDF Forms:** The TODAY system variable, already available in the Word Add-In, is now available in PDF Form templates, resolving to the current date at document generation time. | ### explore | | | | --- | --- | | ![](https://help.neostella.com/hc/article_attachments/43690427372823) | **Allow Manually Entered Values in Defined-Value Report Filters:** Report builders can now manually enter filter values that are no longer available in the current schema, so reports can include records with historical, deprecated, or removed values without modifying the underlying configuration or stored data. | ### finance | | | | --- | --- | | ![](https://help.neostella.com/hc/article_attachments/43690427372823) | **Enhancement invoices view:** Two minor UI adjustments to the Non Invoice Items view and the invoice creation flow, improving clarity and removing an outdated message that is no longer relevant. | ### workflows | | | | --- | --- | | ![](https://help.neostella.com/hc/article_attachments/43690427372823) | **Choose or turn off grouping in the task view:** Case workers can group their task view by Status or Priority — or turn grouping off entirely — so the list is organized around how they're actually working. | | ![](https://help.neostella.com/hc/article_attachments/43690427372823) | **Customize the columns shown in the task view:** Users can choose which columns appear in their task view. A side panel lists every available column with a switch for each one, so a user can strip the grid back to what they care about or bring in extra detail without asking anyone to change the view for them. | | ![](https://help.neostella.com/hc/article_attachments/43690427372823) | **Dark mode fixes:** Some components were not usable in dark mode because their design was not built for that; this development allows users to use Workflows normally in dark mode. | | ![](https://help.neostella.com/hc/article_attachments/43359811751703) | **Second Path From a Starting Rule Cannot Connect to an ANY Join:** Workflow designers are blocked from building a template where two paths coming out of the same starting rule converge on a single rule. The first connection is accepted, the second one is rejected with an error, so a common convergence design cannot be built at all and designers are pushed into duplicating downstream work to get around it. | ## september 9th to september 15th ### adoption | | | | --- | --- | | ![](https://help.neostella.com/hc/article_attachments/43157180181271) | **Update Auto Layout Icon to Match Design Reference**
Minor UX/UI enhancements. | | ![](https://help.neostella.com/hc/article_attachments/43157180181271) | **Implement Faster Container Deployment**
Deployments to the container are now significantly faster thanks to a new deployment strategy being validated across environments before reaching production. This reduces downtime and wait time during releases, ensuring updates reach the platform more quickly and reliably. | | ![](https://help.neostella.com/hc/article_attachments/43157180181271) | **Lead Docket: Avoid duplicated contacts from Leads that are already created by FV projects**
This update includes internal improvements that do not impact the user experience. | | ![](https://help.neostella.com/hc/article_attachments/43157180181271) | **Add Release Pipeline Validation for Unregistered Structure/Data Migrations in Tenant Provisioning JSON**
Any schema or data migration that is missing from the tenant provisioning directory is now automatically caught during the release pipeline before it reaches production, preventing new tenants from being provisioned with an outdated or incomplete schema. This eliminates a silent manual gap that could cause inconsistencies across tenant environments without any visible warning. | | ![](https://help.neostella.com/hc/article_attachments/43157180181271) | **Support Relationship Mapping with Child Objects**
The object map now supports linking more than one Parties instance to the Parties Information relationship field in G-PI Litigation Summary, with each source field group mapping to its own distinct Parties vertex and edge in the graph. Users viewing a migrated Litigation Summary record will see all associated parties correctly reflected through the relationship field. | | ![](https://help.neostella.com/hc/article_attachments/43157180181271) | **Make search in Maps and Executions persistent**
Search inputs in the Maps and Executions views now stay active when navigating away or switching tabs, so specialists never lose their filtered context and can pick up exactly where they left off without retyping their search. | | ![](https://help.neostella.com/hc/article_attachments/43157180181271) | **Bulk Delete and Duplicate Actions for Mappings**
Specialists can now select multiple mappings and delete or duplicate them in a single action, saving significant time when managing large mapping libraries. When duplicating, a custom name can be assigned to each copy so the new maps are organized and identifiable from the start. | | ![](https://help.neostella.com/hc/article_attachments/43157180181271) | **Optimize Mapping Load Time with Priority Content**
The mapping view now loads the most critical entity content first so specialists can start working immediately, while the rest of the content loads progressively in the background. This eliminates the wait time previously caused by loading everything at once and keeps the mapping interactive throughout. | | ![](https://help.neostella.com/hc/article_attachments/43157180181271) | **Improve error UI logs in executions**
When a migration execution fails, users can now see exactly what went wrong at each step — including the object, field, error type, and operator involved — directly in the failure modal without needing to contact engineering or read raw logs. | | ![](https://help.neostella.com/hc/article_attachments/43157163395351) | **Plaintiff Expert Items migration incomplete — only 1 of 3 imported**
Minor bug fixes and internal improvements. | | ![](https://help.neostella.com/hc/article_attachments/43157163395351) | **Provisioning Failures: Default Forms, Owner Lambda Timeout, and MSK Topic Provisioning**
Minor bug fixes and internal improvements. | ### automations | | | | --- | --- | | ![](https://help.neostella.com/hc/article_attachments/43157180181271) | **Update Automations Pipeline Node deprecation**
This update includes internal improvements that do not impact the user experience. | | ![](https://help.neostella.com/hc/article_attachments/43157180181271) | **First UI refinements**
